root.label: FDA foreign food inspections fiscal year 2025

events.label: FDA foreign food inspections fiscal year 2025

slots.name: inspection decline
slots.sentence: Food and Drug Administration inspections of foreign food sites — including the Mexican farm linked to the ongoing outbreak — are down nearly 35% since 2019, the year before the COVID-19 pandemic, according to agency records.

slots.name: inspection workforce
slots.sentence: The FDA’s food inspection workforce includes more than 420 staffers, although 10% to 15% of its positions have been chronically unfilled, according to the GAO and former staffers.

slots.name: food recalls
slots.sentence: According to FDA figures, companies have announced more than 480 food recalls in the current fiscal year, already surpassing four out of the five previous years.

slots.name: inspector travel time percentage
slots.sentence: Inspectors who work internationally can spend 50% or more of their working time traveling, a grueling schedule that has long caused turnover among FDA staff.

slots.name: annual inspection target
slots.sentence: Under the law, the FDA is supposed to inspect more than 19,000 international food sites annually.

slots.name: targeted job terminations
slots.sentence: While inspectors were not among the 3,500 jobs targeted for termination by the Trump administration, the agency did eliminate more than half the staffers who handle travel bookings.
